facts.fact: Jem 深呼吸后告白，被鼻血打断；全家涌进储藏室起哄打赌
Flora 拒绝：不能跟你约会——我不喜欢你那样，对不起
facts.anchor: I can’t go on a date with you. I don’t like you like that. I’m sorry.

facts.fact: Jem 接受但「没法待在你身边」——要搬出去几周
facts.anchor: I’m not sure I can be around you right now knowing that you don’t feel the same.

facts.fact: 她谎称「今早 builder 说房子能住（除淋浴）」好让 Jem 安心让她搬走
facts.anchor: I heard from the builders this morning

facts.fact: 现实：无处可去——Kath 失联、Garett/Ruby 没空房、Mel 没空间、没钱住酒店
facts.anchor: I have nowhere to go and no one who can put me up.

facts.fact: Garett 看出她快崩，清场疏散并教她「如实跟他说」
结尾雨中泪：怎么短短时间就错成这样
facts.anchor: How could so much go so wrong in such a short amount of time?
